question: Which of the following gave the British Indian government enormous powers to repress political activities, and allowed the detention of political prisoners without trial for two years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rowlatt Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Rowlatt Act was passed by the British Indian Government in March 1919.
 
• It gave the government enormous powers to repress political activities.
 
• It allowed the detention of political prisoners without trial for two years.
 
• This act led to widespread anger and protests across India, including the infamous Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Slavery Act**

 
 
• Passed in 1843, it aimed to abolish slavery in British India.
 
• It declared the sale or purchase of any person as a slave illegal.
 
 
 
• **Indian Contract Act**
 
 
• Enacted in 1872, it governs the contractual relationships in India.
 
• It lays down the conditions under which promises made by parties to a contract will be legally binding on them.
 
 
 
• **Negotiable Instruments Act**
 
 
• Passed in 1881, it deals with promissory notes, bills of exchange, and cheques.
 
• It defines the laws relating to the characteristics and functioning of negotiable instruments.
 
 
 
• **Rowlatt Act**
 
 
• Also known as the Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act of 1919.
 
• It was based on the recommendations of the Rowlatt Committee chaired by Sir Sidney Rowlatt.
 
• The act was widely opposed by Indian leaders and led to the Non-Cooperation Movement led by Mahatma Gandhi.
